items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Gene Jackson was my very best friend in the grammar school and so forth.

ctx.x: I was wondering if you had contact with him as a kid. I didn't know.

I had contact with him as a kid but didn't know it. Because his sister and my mother were great friends and his sister ran a cleaning shop on Saint Bernard Street Street near Claybond. And when I would come home from school I would go to his sister's house to stay until my mother and father came home from work, you know, in those early days. He had came, he must have visited his sister at one time or another, but I didn't know because his nephew was named Gene Jackson. And Gene Jackson was my very best friend in…
So you all intersected at that point? But we didn't know. Years later you all went.
